book.name: 2 Kolint
book.title: Pol-ate kaapiya tu yuuh la vu hil bel-ate vu Kolint

content: Hil bel-ate kul nambe landôôvu halindin-aso
+ o 8:1 Lom 15:26*Halingg-aso, saawiingin gatulin vakasin jak Anutu-te samu samu sen wiing-ambe nôôn ak vu hil bel-ate vu Makedoniaa-to vu ham e.

Nimeen bopaata navu sahi sil lôôt lohvu busin pin, le ma de sil oo kand vasa lôôt, tonde silanêênd kupak ma, lemu sil dawiing ngaatum bopaata lôôt-ambe datung salivangin bopaata in nambe dôôvu hil vaalu.

Sa naanêêl langaah in sa lak ni nambe yoo datung salivangin lohvu kand, de omaaho ti me-naanjiihin sil e, tonde silanêênd mone daka sen lohvu nambe sil gatung naatu salivangin-ato ond yik latung. Tonde yik yoo latung heey having-ambe bopaata lôôt savok la.
+ o 8:4 2Ko 9:1-2*Tonde sil oo mokataangg hey lôôt nambe hey aanjiinggis-ande hey gako silate salivangin na Yelusalem in dôôvu Anutu-te hil vuu-ju gaving.

Le sil-ame datung mone malis amu lohvu sen hey akangg navu nambe sil e gatung-ato le, nganjo yoo lavu sil la osin doos tu salivangin vu Omaaho Bop munggin e mem lavu sil lukalaam hey namangg having, lohvu sen Anutu nêêl nambe sil lambiing-ato.
Ondeey hey aanêêl vu Titus nambe kul samu samu sen yoo hatung dangga lak bôôy nambe ham andôôvu hil sen dativak in va yuuh amêê-to ond yik yoo naas-ambe samu kul-anja na.

+ o 8:7 1Ko 1:5; 16:1-2*Va pin sen ham nawiing-ato ond yoo nivasa lôôt. Ham oo nawii-having Anutu niwêêk lôôt, tombe manyinja ham navu taahu hil hôôk Kalisi-te vakasin lôôt. Ham alak vakasin keen ani lôôt, om ham oo nimkala lôôt in nambe ham ambiing Anutu-te kul, tonde ham ahem naving hey lôôt, om sa naanêêl vu ham naambe ham oo pasam ambiing kul in andôôvu hil sen dativak in vaa-to lôôt gaving.
Same aambe sa naanêêl niwêêk vu ham e, nganjo hil-anju lawiing silate kul anivasaa-to ondeey soo aambe sa sahi ham naambe ham e ahem gaving Anutu-te kul keen me malis.

+ o 8:9 Mat 8:20; Pil 2:6-7*Ke, ham oo alak ni nambe yate Omaaho Bop Yesu Kalisi samu yiiy keen. In va nivasa vasa pin danggakook yi, le sim havuuh va nivasa pin-anju la de tu omaaho malis amu in nambe dôôvu ham, tombe yoo lak omaaho malis sen yinêên va maa-ju ondeey ham e gako nôôn anivasa vasa.
Om sa kangg navu nambe ham gatung salivangin naambêênjo ond mem nivasa in ham akam oo vu kul-anjo munggin hil pin-ambe ham hatung salivangin heey lung la hôôk ta ngo bôôy-ato.
Om ham-o, ham samu kul sen ham ahem having-ambe ham anêêl bôôy-ato be jung na le. Yik ham oo nanyem laas-ambe gatung salivangin nohvu mone sen nando vu ham-ato.

+ o 8:12 Mak 12:43*Naambe omaaho ti lopayo yoo nawiingin nambe gatung salivangin, tombe gatung nohvu mone sen nando vu yii-to, ond Anutu le ji yi nivasa, le naambe yinêên va me-nando le, ond Anutu nayi nambe yik lung.
Same aanêêl nambe ham gatung salivangin bopaata in dôôvu hil vaalu de ham ond ham monaativak e, nganjo saawiingin nambe ham pin mando nivasa nanjip ti.

+ o 8:14 2Ko 9:12*Gêên-anjo hamate va ngeeyaata nando, om ham andôôvu sil sen silanêênd va maa-to, tonde sim naalum e naambe silanêênd nando de hamanêêm ma, ond sim landôôvu ham-ambe ham samu ham vaha-vahaan naambêênja.
+ o 8:15 Eks 16:18*Nohvu Anutu-te vakasin neep hôôk kaapiya nambe,

content.text: “Hil sen lasupin vanôôn maana ngeeyaata lôôt-ato, ond lavu vu hil vaalu sen silanêênd vanôôn pasivdaka muu-to having, tombe mem hil sen

content: Kul vaha-so heey lala lalup Kolint
Sa naapêêlis la vu Anutu in wiing-ambe Titus ahe yoo having lôôt in nambe dôôvu ham, yik nambe sen saa-to.
Keen, yoo nanye laas in sate vakasin sen saanêêl nambe dôôvu ham-ato, tombe yik ahe yoo naving ham lôôt om yoo ka vu be laas-anja.
Tonde hey aawiing halingg ti sen hil bel-ate pin dako haale lak in nambe yoo nanêêl Kalisi-te banye nivasa langaah-ato, ond yik laas having Titus-anja.

Tombe yik hil bel-ate pin laholin yi lak in nambe na gaving sa be haay ahondoos gako salivangin samu samu sen yiiy natung-ato na vu hil sen dativak in vaa-to, tombe hey akangg oo la vu kul-anjo be hey naawiing niwêêk lôôt in nambe hey gako Anutu haale jak.
Om hey animbaya nambe omaaheey-ame daanêêl vakasin anipaya jak hey naambe hey-ame nanggin salivangin bopaataa-jo nivasa le.
Yik hey naawiingin nambe hey aambiing va nivalok amu dôôk Omaaho Bop-ame be dôôk omaahonôôn amend gaving.

Om yik hey aawiing yiiy halingg ango in nambe naas gaving maayuuh. Hey sahi omaaho angôô-jo hôôk kul vaha vaha, le hey aahe nambe yoo niwêêk-ambe nawiing lôôt, tombe gêên ahe yoo naving lôôt nambe biing kul-anjo gaving, in wii-having nambe ham e ambiing kul-anjo nivasa.

Tonde Titus ond ham anjak ni naambe sate omaaho sen haay ahondoos naawiing kul hôôk ti in nambe haay aandôôvu ham, de yiiy halingg ayuuh-anjo ond ham anjak ni naambe yuuh lalaas ak hil bel pin haalend, in yuuh dawiing kul-ambe yuuh dako Kalisi haale lak nivasa lôôt.
+ o 8:24 2Ko 7:13-14*Om ham ahem gaving yaal-ambe ham gako yaal jak, tombe hil bel-ate pin lanji be lanjak ni naambe hamate ahe havingin, sen hey nako ham ak vu yaal-ato ond nôôn keen.
